_doc: D20: biblia musical em forma de dados para lyria.py. Texto humano em docs/proposals/d20_trilhas.md. Prompts em ingles (o modelo responde melhor; nao verificado).
title: Rota Brava
palette_prompt: ukulele, marimba, nylon-string acoustic guitar, upright bass played pizzicato, light accordion, glockenspiel, soft hand percussion (cajon, shaker, tambourine); no electric guitar, no synths, no drum kit, no orchestra hits
theme_prompt: a short bright hummable motif in F major: rising leap C-F-A (up a fourth then a third), a step down to G, then a jump up to high C; rhythm two eighth notes, a quarter, an eighth, a dotted quarter; answered by a gentle descending phrase back to F
global_prompt: Warm, friendly, playful and safe for small children; never scary, never aggressive. Clean acoustic mix, intimate room, no heavy reverb. Seamless loop: ends ready to restart from the beginning, no fade-out.

village.label: vila de dia (tema)
village.prompt: sunny seaside village by day, kids exploring the harbour and the market. Marimba carries the main theme, ukulele strums on the offbeat, pizzicato bass, light shaker and cajon; accordion answers the theme in the second half.
village.form: 4/4, two 8-bar phrases, the theme stated clearly twice.

mystery.label: misterio / pista
mystery.prompt: curious detective moment, following little footprints, tiptoe feeling, wonder not fear. Plucked pizzicato bass walking softly, glockenspiel plays the theme slowly in fragments, nylon guitar harmonics, very sparse shaker.
mystery.form: 4/4, light and sparse, lots of space, theme fragments only.

boat.label: barco
boat.prompt: small boat gliding over calm waves in the bay, rocking motion. Ukulele and nylon guitar in a lilting 6/8 rhythm, accordion holds long notes like a sea breeze, marimba plays the theme in a swaying version.
boat.form: 6/8 barcarolle feel, gentle rocking, theme in long notes.

lighthouse.label: farol
lighthouse.key: D minor rising to F major
lighthouse.prompt: climbing the lighthouse at dusk to switch its lamp back on, gentle anticipation that grows into warm relief. Starts with pizzicato bass and soft marimba in D minor, adds glockenspiel sparkles, and the theme arrives in F major on accordion and marimba at the end.
lighthouse.form: 4/4, slow build from sparse to full, no drums until the last phrase.

festival.label: festa a noite
festival.prompt: Lantern Festival at night in the village square, everyone dancing. Full palette: accordion and marimba play the theme together, ukulele strumming, tambourine, cajon and handclaps, bouncy pizzicato bass.
festival.form: 4/4, festive dance, theme played twice with a happy final cadence leading back to the start.

mission_win.label: vitoria de missao
mission_win.prompt: very short victory fanfare (about 4 seconds): the full theme once on marimba and accordion, ending on a bright F major chord with a glockenspiel sparkle. One-shot, not a loop, with a natural short ending.

badge.label: emblema
badge.prompt: tiny reward jingle (about 3 seconds): glockenspiel and marimba play the first rising notes of the theme C-F-A-high C, then a ukulele strum. One-shot, not a loop.

hero_switch.label: troca de heroi
hero_switch.prompt: very short handover cue (about 2 seconds): quick marimba pickup of the theme's first three notes C-F-A and a soft tambourine hit. One-shot, not a loop.
